summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes. Results: test/test_path.py and the new tests pass (41 passed), and all of test/test_extras passes (99 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing was committed and no existing file was modified. Design choices: an isinstance(..., Node) guard rejects non-node inputs, because a None subject would otherwise act as a wildcard in Graph.value; modifier values are literal "*", "+", "?" at the call sites; list lengths are checked before parsing items. Not verified: black, isort, ruff and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and import order were checked by hand.
